title: psyllium chamaepsyllium
intro: Psyllium chamaepsyllium, commonly known as Indian plantago or Isabgol, is a type of flowering plant in the plantain family that serves as a natural fiber supplement. It is known to provide various health benefits, including promoting digestive regularity, lowering cholesterol levels, and aiding in weight management due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium chamaepsyllium include its ability to bulk up stool, soften it, and prevent constipation, as well as its potential in managing symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The bioactive constituents of Psyllium chamaepsyllium include mucilages, polysaccharides, and fiber, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
